scope: Local numerical audit and regression verification; not operational validation or a new LinuxONE measurement.

source_state.working_tree: Uncommitted physics fixes included; hashes describe final audited physics source and tests.
source_state.sha256_method: SHA256 of sorted compact JSON mapping each relative physics source/fixture/test path to SHA256 of its bytes.

regression_tests.method: Added regressions before fixes; observed failures, then passing targeted and complete pytest runs.

fixes: Search smooth trajectory segments using the correct one-sided velocity at each impulse, preventing missed pre-burn closest approaches.
Provide Gaussian-scale quadrature breakpoints so a concentrated near-certain collision cannot silently integrate to zero.
Publish tightly rechecked risks and encounters, recompute introduced-secondary flags, and omit withheld recommendation trajectories.
Distinguish numerically valid threshold rejection from verification success using verification.status=rejected.

synthetic_stress_test.provenance: Scratch run started before the final verification.status label clarification and removal of a redundant assignment; acceptance, risk integration, encounter search, and tight-risk reporting algorithms match the audited source. A fresh final-source LinuxONE run is required for release evidence.
synthetic_stress_test.timing_limitation: Local shared VM ran other tests concurrently; these durations are not a controlled performance benchmark.

limitations: Pinned NASA cases validate selected probability integrals; they do not validate the complete planner or operational orbital predictions.
Synthetic scenarios use two-body gravity, prescribed independent RTN position uncertainty, a short rectilinear encounter approximation, and instantaneous burns.
Only a finite candidate grid and three uncertainty scales are screened; this is not a global optimum or safety guarantee.
Slow co-orbital cases and partial horizon-boundary encounters remain outside the declared scenario suite; off-TCA boundary points are skipped by the existing model.
